 Real Madrid announce squad for La Liga match against Valencia
 by Lucas Navarrete Nov 6, 2026, 4:57 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid have published their squad list for Saturday’s match against Valencia.
 REAL MADRID SQUAD LIST:
Goalkeepers : Courtois, Lunin, and Mestre.
 Defenders : Militão, Huijsen, Trent, Konaté, Cucurella, Á. Carreras, Rüdiger, and Dumfries.
 Midfielders : Bellingham, Camavinga, Valverde, Tchouameni, Arda Güler, Bernardo, and Thiago.
 Forwards : Endrick, Mbappé, C. Espí, Brahim, and Yan Diomande.
 Tchouameni and Arda Güler return to the list after missing Wednesday’s match in Athens, so they should be fresh and ready to face what’s expected to be an intense and physical game at Mestalla.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGA 
 Date : 11/07/2026
 Time : 21:00 CET, 03:00pm EST.
 Venue : Mestalla, Valencia, Spain.
 Available TV : DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).
 Available Streaming : ESPN+ (USA)
